verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports show macOS ships built-in, first-party command-line utilities usable without extra installs: pbcopy/pbpaste for clipboard piping, networkQuality, qlmanage for SVG-to-PNG conversion, and hidutil for key remapping. That is real but scattered evidence of an official CLI surface. It is not documented in the first-party evidence and is not framed for AI-native or agent workflows. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the CLI tooling, any evidence of CLI coverage of AI/Siri or automation features (e.g. Shortcuts from the command line), and a coherent official CLI aimed at agentic use.
